subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require an exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream fixture before accepting any recovery path that reclassifies assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The safest fix depends on whether maintainers want to wait for a proven stream fixture or sponsor a provider-specific recovery design despite the tool-execution boundary risk.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the remaining failure, then fix only the proven parser path.

options.title: Sponsor narrow recovery design
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned provider-specific recovery path if exact reproduction is impractical, with false-promotion tests and security review.

options.title: Treat existing workaround as enough
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the documented vLLM tool-choice workaround covers this deployment class despite the reporter's structured-wire evidence.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the remaining failure, then fix only the proven parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged history in the same OpenAI-compatible reasoning/tool-call parser path.
